summary: Verizon ABS II LLC, as Depositor/Registrant for Verizon Master Trust, filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose retention of counsel in connection with its Form SF-3 registration statement. Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP and Morris James LLP were retained; legal opinions as to legality, Delaware law, and tax matters were filed as Exhibits 5.1, 5.2, and 8.1, with corresponding consents. The filing also references an offering of asset-backed notes, including $826,008,000 Class A-1a 5.14% Asset Backed Notes and $65,000,000 of another class. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, or deal terms are stated.
